tasks.short: Write the monthly finance pack and commentary for the Finance Director and site managers after close.

today.trigger: Month-end close is finished in AFAS, usually around working day 6 to 8.
steps: Export trial balance and cost-centre results per site from AFAS into Excel
Refresh Power BI finance pages and check they match AFAS
Compare actuals with budget and last year, and look up the causes of large variances
Write commentary per site (Rotterdam, Tilburg, Venlo) and per cost type, including flex labour
Send the pack by Outlook and walk through it in the management meeting
drudgery: Copy-pasting AFAS exports into the same Excel template every month
Chasing site managers by mail for the reason behind a variance
Re-checking that Power BI and AFAS totals agree
today.time_sinks: Finding the explanation for variances, especially flex worker costs where agency invoices arrive late, takes more time than writing the report.

lenses.faster: A fixed pipeline pulls AFAS figures into the pack and ties them to the trial balance; an LLM drafts variance commentary from the ledger lines and agency hours, so the accountant edits instead of writes.
lenses.autonomous: When the period is locked in AFAS, the pack builds itself overnight and the draft lands in the accountant's inbox with open questions per variance.
lenses.ambitious: Each site manager gets a short weekly view of labour cost against volume, not just a monthly pack, so the business sees problems before close.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses the copy-paste and template formatting; what remains is finding the real story behind the numbers and talking it through with managers.
lenses.options: The draft offers two or three readings of a big variance (timing, price, volume) with the ledger evidence for each, and the accountant picks.
lenses.altitude: The accountant owns the variance thresholds, the commentary rules and the tie-out checks, and reviews the pack rather than building it.
reach: FP&A Analyst: first-pass budget against actual analysis
Controller: drafting the management letter section of the close

tasks.human_edge: Knowing which variance matters to this management team, getting the real reason from a site manager, and saying a hard message in the meeting.
tasks.pattern_why: The numbers and tie-outs are deterministic from AFAS; the commentary turns structured variances and loose notes into text that a person can check against the figures.

in_practice.trigger: Period status set to closed in AFAS Profit.
steps: Scheduled job extracts trial balance, cost centres and agency hours from AFAS and agency portals
Script computes variances against budget and prior year and checks totals against the trial balance
LLM drafts commentary per variance above threshold, citing ledger lines
Accountant edits, adds manager input and approves
Pack is published to Power BI and SharePoint and mailed
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant approves every commentary line and the Controller signs off the pack before it is sent.
data_needed: Trial balance per site and cost centre
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint close folder with draft, edits and approver per month

evidence.claim: Accountants using AI closed the month 7.5 days faster across 79 firms.
LLMs draft variance commentary from structured financial tables reliably enough for review.

risks: Plausible but wrong variance explanations that nobody checks
Late agency invoices make the draft confidently wrong on flex costs
Managers stop reading a pack that looks auto-generated
research_questions: How many hours per month do the two accountants spend on the pack today, split by gathering and writing?
How often would a drafted explanation have matched the real cause on the last six months' variances?
Does the AFAS nightly extract hold cost-centre detail fine enough for site commentary?

tasks.short: Prepare and file VAT returns and the corporate tax return, and check payments to the Belastingdienst.

today.trigger: VAT period end (monthly or quarterly) and the annual corporate tax deadline.
steps: Run the VAT report in AFAS and reconcile it with the VAT ledger accounts
Check reverse-charge, intra-EU and import VAT postings and the ICP listing
Correct coding errors and post adjustments
Prepare the return in AFAS and file it
Schedule payment in the Rabobank batch and keep the workpaper
drudgery: Line-by-line checking of VAT codes on purchase invoices
Rebuilding the same reconciliation workbook every period
Looking up reverse-charge rules for odd foreign suppliers
today.time_sinks: Finding and fixing wrongly coded VAT on purchase invoices, and the corporate tax adjustments at year end.

lenses.faster: Scripted checks reconcile VAT accounts with the return and flag invoices whose VAT code does not fit supplier country, amount or ledger, and Jonas helps fill the return, so only the flagged items need a person.
lenses.autonomous: After each period lock, the VAT check runs by itself and produces a reconciled draft return with an exception list.
lenses.ambitious: Every purchase invoice is VAT-checked when it is booked, not at period end, which also prepares Noordhaven for e-invoicing and reporting from 2030 to 2031.
lenses.joy: The tedious code-by-code checking goes; left is resolving the real edge cases and tax rules, which accountants tend to enjoy.
lenses.options: For corporate tax, the accountant gets side-by-side computations under different treatments (for example of a provision) with the tax effect of each.
lenses.altitude: The accountant maintains the VAT rule set and test cases and reviews exceptions, instead of preparing returns by hand.
reach: Bookkeeper: VAT coding checks at invoice entry
Controller: first draft of the tax section of the annual accounts

tasks.human_edge: Judging grey-area treatments, signing off estimates, and dealing with the Belastingdienst and the external tax adviser.
tasks.pattern_why: VAT rules on structured AFAS data can be written down and the output reconciles to the ledger; Jonas assists in the return itself, and estimates stay with a person.

steps: Rule engine checks every VAT-coded line against supplier country, code and account
Reconciliation ties VAT ledger accounts to the return boxes and the ICP listing
Exceptions list goes to the accountant with suggested corrections
Accountant corrects, Jonas assists in completing the return in AFAS
Controller approves filing and the payment batch
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant clears every exception and the Controller approves the return and payment before filing.
data_needed: Supplier master data with country and VAT number
in_practice.logs_to: Tax workpaper folder on SharePoint with rule run output, exceptions and sign-off

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas assists in corporate tax returns and from 2026 in VAT returns; the user remains responsible for the check.
Tax estimates belong on the mandatory human review list for AI in accounting.
No benchmark yet covers Dutch VAT.

risks: Rule set misses a rare cross-border case and errors go unflagged
Overreliance on Jonas output without a check
E-invoicing rules change before the rules are updated
research_questions: What share of VAT corrections in the last year would a rule check have caught at booking?
Is Jonas VAT support available in Noordhaven's AFAS version and licence?
Does the external tax adviser accept a scripted reconciliation as workpaper?

tasks.short: Review the balance sheet and P&L each month for odd balances, movements and missing accruals.

today.trigger: Month-end close, after the bookkeepers finish postings.
steps: Run trial balance and balance sheet comparisons in AFAS and Excel
Scan for unusual movements, negative balances and old open items
Check fixed assets, provisions, accruals and intercompany balances
Ask bookkeepers or budget holders about unexplained items
Post or request correcting entries
drudgery: Eyeballing hundreds of accounts for what changed
Re-doing the same flux analysis template
Chasing explanations by mail
today.time_sinks: Scanning every account to find the few that matter, then waiting for explanations.

lenses.faster: A script ranks every account by unexpected movement and age of open items, and an LLM summarises the underlying lines, so review starts at the ten accounts that matter.
lenses.autonomous: Each night during close, the balance review reruns on fresh AFAS data and updates an exception list with owners.
lenses.ambitious: Every account gets reviewed every month with a documented explanation, which most mid-sized firms only manage at year end.
lenses.joy: The scanning goes; left is the detective work on the items that are actually wrong.
lenses.options: For each flagged item the tool proposes likely causes and a possible correcting entry for the accountant to choose from.
lenses.altitude: The accountant sets thresholds and expected patterns per account and tunes them as false alarms show up.
reach: Controller: balance sheet sign-off preparation
Auditor support: pre-audit account analysis

tasks.human_edge: Knowing the business context behind a movement and deciding what is an error versus a real event.
tasks.pattern_why: Movement detection is deterministic; turning ledger lines and notes into an explanation the accountant can check is an LLM step inside it.

in_practice.trigger: Close calendar day 2, and nightly until period lock.
steps: Extract balances and lines from AFAS
Compute flux, ageing and threshold breaches per account
LLM summarises drivers of each flagged account from the lines
Accountant reviews, asks owners and proposes entries
Entries prepared for posting after approval
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant decides on every flagged item; correcting entries need Controller approval to post.
in_practice.logs_to: Close checklist on SharePoint with explanation per account

evidence.claim: Multi-step reasoning across files is a main failure mode of leading models on accounting tasks.
AI agents prepare entries for human review rather than posting them.

risks: Too many false alarms so reviewers skim
Summary adds an assumption that is not in the data
Thresholds hide small but systematic errors
research_questions: How many audit adjustments last year sat in accounts a flux rule would have flagged?
What false alarm rate is acceptable to the accountants?
Can the AFAS extract give line-level detail daily during close?

tasks.short: Write up findings from internal control checks and audit work, with risks and actions.

today.trigger: End of an internal control review, the external audit interim, or a found issue.
steps: Collect test results, samples and evidence in Excel and SharePoint
Decide which findings are material
Write findings with cause, risk and recommendation in Word
Agree actions and owners with the Controller and process owners
Track follow-up
drudgery: Reformatting test results into the report template
Rewriting the same type of finding each year
Chasing owners for action dates
today.time_sinks: Writing clear, defensible findings and agreeing actions with owners.

lenses.faster: An LLM drafts each finding in the standard format from the test output and evidence, so the accountant edits wording and severity.
lenses.autonomous: When a control test fails, a finding draft with evidence links is created and the owner is asked for a response.
lenses.ambitious: Findings come from tests over all transactions every month, so control reporting becomes continuous instead of yearly.
lenses.joy: Less template writing; more time on what the finding means and how to fix the process.
lenses.options: Several recommendation options with effort and residual risk per finding.
lenses.altitude: The accountant designs the finding template, severity rules and follow-up workflow.
reach: Controller: audit committee and external auditor reporting
Finance Director: control status in management reporting

tasks.human_edge: Judging materiality, agreeing the message with owners and standing behind it with the auditor.
tasks.pattern_why: Structured test results turn into structured, checkable text; the person checks it against the evidence.

in_practice.trigger: A control test run marks a failure or a review is closed.
steps: Test output and evidence are collected in the SharePoint review folder
LLM drafts finding, risk and recommendation in the template
Accountant sets severity and edits
Owner adds response and date in a Teams task or list
Report compiled and approved by the Controller
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant approves each finding; the Controller approves the report.
in_practice.logs_to: Findings register on SharePoint with versions and approvals

evidence.claim: A model can add an unnoticed assumption so the workpaper cannot be rebuilt.
LLMs draft structured audit findings from test data.

risks: Overstated or understated severity in drafted text
Confidential data such as payroll findings sent to an unapproved tool (AVG)
Findings become boilerplate and lose force
research_questions: How many findings reports are written per year and how long does each take?
Does the external auditor accept findings drafted with AI if evidence links are kept?
Which tool is approved for handling payroll-related findings under AVG?

tasks.short: Work out Noordhaven's own tax positions: depreciation, provisions, interest deduction, deferred tax.

today.trigger: Year end, quarterly provisional tax estimate, or a major transaction such as a lease or asset purchase.
steps: Pull fixed asset, lease, loan and provision data from AFAS
Compute fiscal versus commercial depreciation and deferred tax in Excel
Check interest deduction limits and other corporate tax rules
Discuss positions with the external tax adviser
Book the tax charge and document the position
drudgery: Maintaining fiscal asset registers next to the commercial one in Excel
Re-running present value and amortisation schedules by hand
today.time_sinks: Building and checking calculation workbooks and waiting on adviser input.

lenses.faster: Code-based schedules compute depreciation, present values and deferred tax from AFAS data, and an assistant explains each step, cutting workbook building.
lenses.autonomous: Fiscal and commercial schedules update monthly so the tax estimate is always current.
lenses.ambitious: Monthly tax provision instead of year-end, so the forecast includes tax the business can trust.
lenses.joy: No fragile Excel; left is reasoning about the position, which is the interesting part.
lenses.options: Scenarios for treatments of a lease or provision with tax and cash effect side by side.
lenses.altitude: The accountant owns the calculation model and its tests and reviews the outcomes.
reach: FP&A Analyst: tax in the forecast
Controller: tax note in the annual accounts

tasks.human_edge: Choosing a defensible tax position and owning it with the adviser and the Belastingdienst.
tasks.pattern_why: These are judgement-heavy estimates that must be human-approved; AI computes and explains, the accountant decides.

in_practice.trigger: Quarter end or a new material transaction.
steps: Pull asset, lease and loan data from AFAS
Scripted schedules compute fiscal positions
Assistant drafts a position memo with calculations
Accountant reviews with the tax adviser
Controller approves the booked tax charge
in_practice.human_gate: Every estimate and memo is approved by the accountant and the Controller, with adviser review for material items.

evidence.claim: Judgement, not retrieval, is the bottleneck on accounting tasks; 58% of tasks never fully solved.
Tax estimates need mandatory human review.
No benchmark covers Dutch tax positions.

risks: Model applies US rules to a Dutch position
Assumptions hidden in schedules
Liability stays with Noordhaven whatever the tool says
research_questions: How many hours a year go into fiscal schedules and deferred tax today?
Would the tax adviser review scripted schedules instead of Excel?
How accurate is an assistant on Dutch corporate tax questions tested against past adviser memos?

tasks.short: Check AFAS and finance processes for weak controls and data errors, and propose fixes.

today.trigger: Annual control review, auditor management letter, or an incident such as a fraudulent IBAN change.
steps: Walk through processes and AFAS role settings
Pull samples of master data changes and approvals
Test segregation of duties and approval limits
Write recommendations and agree them with IT and process owners
drudgery: Manual sampling of supplier and IBAN changes
Exporting and comparing user rights lists
today.time_sinks: Pulling and testing samples by hand, which still covers only a few transactions.

lenses.faster: Scripts test every transaction for duplicates, IBAN changes before payment, approvals over limit and segregation of duties conflicts in AFAS roles.
lenses.autonomous: The tests run daily and alert on a suspicious IBAN change before the Rabobank payment batch goes out.
lenses.ambitious: Full-population testing of procure to pay and payroll payments, including matching agency invoices to hours, which samples never covered.
lenses.joy: No sampling grind; left is designing controls and talking with owners about better processes.
lenses.options: For each weakness, alternative controls (preventive in AFAS, detective by script) with cost and effect.
lenses.altitude: The accountant writes and maintains the test library and decides which controls are worth automating.
reach: Bookkeeper: duplicate payment checks
Payroll Specialist: payroll payment checks
HRIS Analyst: AFAS role reviews

tasks.human_edge: Judging which control fits the business and persuading owners and IT to change how they work.
tasks.pattern_why: Control tests are rules over structured AFAS and bank data with checkable output.

in_practice.trigger: Daily schedule and before every payment batch.
steps: Extract payments, master data change log, user roles and agency invoices
Run the test library over all records
Send exceptions to the accountant and block-list for the payment batch
Accountant investigates and records outcome
Quarterly review of tests and new control recommendations
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant handles each exception; control changes are approved by the Controller and, for AFAS roles, IT.
in_practice.logs_to: Control test log with exceptions and outcomes on SharePoint

evidence.claim: Deterministic tests over every transaction (duplicates, segregation of duties, IBAN changes) are the recommended pattern for control work.

risks: Payroll-related data processing needs a works council and AVG check if it monitors employees
Alert fatigue
Tests not updated when AFAS changes
research_questions: Does the AFAS change log for supplier IBANs give user and timestamp in the extract?
How many duplicate or wrong payments were found last year by other means?
Does the OR need to approve tests that touch employee user activity?

tasks.short: Prepare the annual accounts and notes, and check them before the audit and KVK filing.

today.trigger: Year end, and the auditor's planning.
steps: Close the year in AFAS and prepare lead schedules in Excel
Draft balance sheet, P&L and notes in Word
Tie every figure back to the trial balance
Answer auditor questions and process adjustments
Prepare the filing for KVK
drudgery: Re-typing figures from Excel into Word
Re-checking ties after every adjustment
Updating last year's notes text
today.time_sinks: Tie-outs after each late adjustment and the back and forth with the auditor.

lenses.faster: Lead schedules and statements are generated from the AFAS trial balance with automatic tie-outs; an LLM drafts updated notes from last year's text and the new figures.
lenses.autonomous: Every adjustment reruns the statements and tie-outs, so the set is always consistent.
lenses.ambitious: Quarterly mini annual accounts, so year end is a confirmation and audit adjustments drop.
lenses.joy: No re-typing and re-ticking; left is judging presentation and disclosures.
lenses.options: Alternative disclosure wordings and presentation choices to discuss with the Controller.
lenses.altitude: The accountant owns the mapping from ledger to statements and the tie-out rules.
reach: Controller: audit file preparation
FP&A Analyst: year-end analysis

tasks.human_edge: Disclosure judgement, the auditor relationship and accountability for the accounts.
tasks.pattern_why: Figures and tie-outs are deterministic; drafting notes from figures is an LLM step checked by the tie-out gate and the accountant.

in_practice.trigger: Year-end trial balance available, and every later adjustment.
steps: Map trial balance to statement lines
Generate statements and lead schedules with tie-out checks
LLM drafts notes text changes
Accountant reviews and resolves differences
Controller and auditor review; filing prepared outside AFAS
in_practice.human_gate: Tie-outs must pass and the accountant and Controller sign off before the set goes to the auditor.
in_practice.logs_to: Year-end file on SharePoint with versions

evidence.claim: Large companies file accounts with KVK via SBR from FY2025; AFAS cannot file this for them.
Claude Opus 5 outperformed licensed CPAs on four month-end scenarios, but the study excludes judgement and communication.

risks: Dutch GAAP disclosure errors not caught by any benchmark
SBR filing tool still separate
Auditor reliance questions
research_questions: How many tie-out cycles happened in the last year end?
Which SBR filing tool will Noordhaven use and can it take the generated statements?
Does the auditor accept generated lead schedules?

tasks.short: Check records and talk to staff, for example at sites, to confirm transactions are booked correctly and lawfully.

today.trigger: Audit plan, a site visit, or a signal such as unexplained stock or flex labour costs.
steps: Select samples of transactions in AFAS
Collect supporting documents from sites and agencies
Interview site staff about how they record hours, receipts and expenses
Compare practice with policy and law
Report gaps
drudgery: Gathering documents by mail
Building sample lists
today.time_sinks: Collecting evidence and scheduling interviews across three sites and shifts.

lenses.faster: Scripts pick risk-based samples and match documents automatically; an assistant prepares interview questions per site from the exceptions.
lenses.autonomous: Document matching for samples runs on its own and requests missing evidence from owners.
lenses.ambitious: Every site gets a yearly process check, including flex worker hours from all three agencies.
lenses.joy: Less chasing paper; more time on the floor understanding how work is really done.
lenses.options: Several sampling designs with coverage and effort shown.
lenses.altitude: The accountant designs the risk model and sampling rules.
reach: HR Administrator: checks on flex worker registration
Controller: compliance review

tasks.human_edge: Interviews, reading people, building trust at sites and judging compliance.
tasks.pattern_why: The person leads the inquiry and interviews; AI prepares samples, documents and questions.

in_practice.trigger: Audit plan date or a risk signal.
steps: Script selects risk-based samples from AFAS
Evidence matched and gaps listed
Assistant drafts interview guide
Accountant interviews and records conclusions
Findings drafted for review
in_practice.human_gate: Accountant draws all conclusions; interviews stay human.

evidence.claim: AI benchmark results exclude client communication, asking the right questions and building tacit context.

risks: Interview notes contain personal data (AVG)
Staff see checks as surveillance; OR involvement needed
Samples miss what interviews would reveal
research_questions: How many site checks per year happen now?
Does the works council need to be consulted on risk-based checks involving staff?
Can agency portals export hours at the level needed for matching?

role.altitude: From preparing reports, returns and checks by hand to owning the rules, tie-outs, control tests and calculation models that produce them, and reviewing exceptions and judgements.
reach: Bookkeeper: VAT and duplicate payment checks at booking
FP&A Analyst: budget against actual commentary
Controller: close pack, tax note and audit file preparation
Payroll Specialist: payroll payment checks
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: AFAS role reviews
role.ceiling_note: About 40 to 50% of hours on these tasks can move to software and drafts; the limit is judgement on tax positions and disclosures, liability for filed returns and accounts, interviews at sites, and works council and AVG constraints on checks that touch employees.
skills_to_grow: Writing control tests and tie-outs in SQL or Python over AFAS extracts
Reviewing AI drafts for hidden assumptions
Dutch VAT and e-invoicing changes 2030 to 2031
role.ambitious_version: Two accountants run continuous accounting: every transaction tested daily, the balance sheet reviewed monthly with explanations, a monthly tax provision and a close in three days that the business trusts.
